**Chinese name:** 摩尔线程智能科技（北京）有限责任公司 (Mó'ěr Xiànchéng Zhìnéng Kējì (Běijīng) Yǒuxiàn Zérèn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded June 2020 by Zhang Jianzhong, Nvidia's former China general manager; filed for a mainland China IPO in late 2024 and completed it on the Shanghai STAR Market on December 5, 2025 at an issue price of ¥114.28/share — the stock later traded as high as ¥657.02 intraday. Added to the Entity List the same day as Biren (October 17, 2023), underscoring how directly the US targeted China's two leading GPU startups together. On 7 August 2026 its board approved a plan to pursue an H-share listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (announced 9–10 August); a special shareholders' meeting approved the H-share plan (≤10% of post-issuance shares plus a 15% greenshoe) on 28 August 2026, though no CSRC overseas-listing filing or HKEX A1 had been published as of 11 October 2026.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Consumer and data-center GPUs, explicitly positioned in domestic coverage as 'China's answer to Nvidia.' H1 2026 (filing 9 August): revenue ¥1.736 billion (+147.4% YoY — already more than full-year 2025's ¥1.506 billion), cloud/data-center products 97.5% of sales, headline net loss narrowed 95.7% to ¥11.6 million (still ¥151 million loss on an adjusted basis) with gross margin 56.95%; the Kuae (夸娥) cluster business booked ¥660 million of contracted sales in the half. Next-generation '花港' architecture (unpublished December 2025) targets >100,000-card clusters.
